storeListing.shortDescription: Audits source code for energy waste and returns a green score with a ranked fix plan.
storeListing.fullDescription: GreenCode measures the carbon cost of software. Ask it to audit a snippet or a GitHub repository and it returns a 0-100 green score, the exact energy anti-patterns it found (nested loops, quadratic string building, repeated allocations), Software Carbon Intensity against the live grid of your chosen region, and a ranked remediation plan. Every energy figure states whether it came from a hardware counter or a TDP model, and every carbon figure names its data source and freshness - so an answer can be defended in an audit, not just quoted. Tools: audit_code, audit_repository, audit_and_score, calculate_sci, measure_energy, get_grid_intensity, compare_regions, refactor_code.
examplePhrases: Audit this Python function for energy waste
What is the green score of my code snippet?
Should we run this batch job in Ireland or Virginia?
